description: WAMSI 2 - Kimberley Node - 1.3.2 - Climate Change Reef Calcification is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Australian Marine Science Institution. The overall objectives of this project are to understand how corals, the key ecosystem engineers on tropical reefs, have adapted and will respond in the future to the extreme variations in physical (e. g. light, temperature, water motion) and chemical (e. pCO2, oxygen, and nutrients) conditions characteristic of the Kimberley coastal region. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Western Australian Marine Science Institution. It offers 3 resource(s) in .tab, html, wms. The portal shows 2022-05-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
